name: Relational Quantum Mechanics (RQM)
one_line: Relational Quantum Mechanics (RQM) asserts that the state of a quantum system is observer-dependent.

math_relation_to_SQM.equations_summary: RQM uses the standard mathematical formalism of SQM but reinterprets its meaning. The state vector |Ψ⟩ is not an absolute description of a system, but a book-keeping device for the correlations between that system and an observer.

key_claims: The state of a system S is always relative to an observer O. It is meaningless to speak of the absolute state of S.
Any physical system can be an 'observer'. There is no fundamental distinction between observer and observed.
All physical facts are established through interactions. A system acquires properties relative to another system only when they interact.
